progression.narrative: The performance opens on Bb3 and dwells most on D in Daramad-e Sevom. The line peaks at D5 (568.6 Hz) at 0:03.3. It closes on the tonic (Bb4 → Bb4 → C5 → Bb4 → G4 → G4).
